notes.title: Monkey Split Patch Notes 0.6
notes.notes:
Hello there fellow crazy monkeys. 

Sorry for taking so long with this new update.

This is more of a performance and bugs improvement, so you can have a lot of fun bug free.

Hope you play a lot of Monkey SPlit now

notes.title: Monkey Split Patch Notes 0.5
notes.notes:
Hello there fellow crazy monkeys. 

One more week, and one more patch, this one is the biggest we ever had. 

Introducing a new game mode, Ice Crysis, go and slip away in the new cold map. 

We also made a remake of the common map, now it's the Playground! 

Hope you have lot's of fun in the new maps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/8841b4663da6331451d9716b294290cebf9741b3.png[/img]

notes.title: Monkey Split Patch Notes 0.4
notes.notes:

Hope you follow us until the end.
